name: Nega Sarajigo Naega Namatda
source:
Out on a brief errand for his mother, the protagonist, Furu Asai, was suddenly kidnapped. But as he looked around, he quickly realized he wasn't the only victim.
Including Furu, eleven people in total had been taken.
Determined to break free, the group began investigating the Akai Hotel, searching for a way to escape...
translation:
奉母亲之命出门跑一趟小差事的主角浅井古，半路上突然遭人绑架。然而当他环顾四周时，很快便意识到受害者并非只有自己一人。
算上浅井古在内，共有十一人被掳至此地。
下定决心逃出生天的众人开始在“赤井酒店”内展开调查，全力寻找脱困的出路……
